Regime周期: Goldilocks理想增长?The macro / economic regime (growth × inflation quadrant) the whole page is filtered by — it describes the ECONOMY, not today's tape, so it shifts slowly. Use it for which sectors & factors are favoured, not for market timing. For whether the market itself is turning over, use the Macro dashboard's Risk Radar.整页据以过滤的宏观／经济周期（增长×通胀象限）— 它描述的是经济，而非今日盘面，因此变化缓慢。用于判断哪些板块与因子占优，而非择时。市场本身是否转向，请看宏观看板中的风险雷达。 Posture姿态: NEUTRAL中性?How to TRADE the current regime — a defensive → aggressive stance dial (Defensive · Careful · Neutral · Constructive · Aggressive) set by the playbook. “Careful” means lean cautious: favour quality and good entries, keep gross moderate. It sizes risk; it is not a buy/sell or stock-selection call. The full dial with its reasoning lives on the Macro dashboard.如何“交易”当前周期 — 一个防御→进取的姿态刻度（防御·谨慎·中性·建设性·进取），由策略手册设定。“谨慎”意为偏审慎：偏好质量与好的入场点，总仓位保持适中。它用于调整风险敞口，并非买卖或选股建议。完整刻度及其推理见宏观看板。

Where to look for stocks — standouts, sector rotation, factor tilts and real fund flows, filtered by the current macro regime.在哪里找股票 — 精选个股、板块轮动、因子倾斜与基金真实资金流，按当前宏观周期过滤。 ← Macro regime dashboard宏观周期看板  ·  🧪 Pick Lab选股实验室

US equity scoreboard — size, breadth & internals美股计分板 — 规模、广度与内部结构 ?Three reads of how broad the US equity advance is, in one board. (1) SIZE & STYLE — small caps (Russell 2000) and mid caps measured against the large-cap S&P 500 (rising = participation broadening/risk-on, falling = a narrow mega-cap-led tape) plus the growth-vs-value style rotation; direction over the last 20 trading days, size ratios coloured by risk-on direction, growth/value left neutral. (2) MARKET BREADTH — across the full S&P Composite 1500 (large = S&P 500, mid = S&P 400, small = S&P 600): how many stocks are advancing, how many hold above their 50- and 200-day lines, and net new 52-week highs; the % above the 50-day line also feeds the regime model's growth axis, so this is the same breadth the model reads, just made legible. (3) MARKET INTERNALS — the classic desk internals beyond the %-above-MA snapshot: the McClellan Oscillator & Summation Index (breadth momentum), the Zweig Breadth Thrust gauge, the High-Low Index, whether the advance/decline line confirms price, and where participation sits in its own multi-decade history; computed on the DEEP S&P 500 breadth series (1962-). Internals are SECOND-DERIVATIVE, display-only reads — coincident with price by construction, they explain the tape, they do not forecast it (survivorship caveat: the deep series is rebuilt from today's members, so percentile context is over the mature-universe window only).把美股上涨的广度用三种读数汇于一板。(1) 规模与风格 —— 小盘（罗素2000）与中盘对大盘标普500衡量（上行 = 参与度扩散／风险偏好，下行 = 狭窄、由超大盘主导的盘面），并含成长对价值的风格轮动；看过去20个交易日的方向，规模比率按风险偏好方向着色，成长／价值保持中性。(2) 市场广度 —— 覆盖整个标普综合1500（大盘=标普500、中盘=标普400、小盘=标普600）：多少股票上涨、多少守在其50日与200日均线之上，以及净创52周新高；高于50日线的占比也进入周期模型的增长轴，与模型读取的是同一广度，只是更直观。(3) 市场内部结构 —— 超越「高于均线占比」快照的经典桌面内部指标：麦克莱伦振荡指标与累积指标（广度动量）、兹威格广度脉冲、新高—新低指数、腾落线是否确认价格，以及当前参与度在其数十年历史中的分位；基于标普500深度广度序列（1962年起）计算。内部结构是二阶、仅作展示的读数 —— 与价格同步，用于解释盘面而非预测（幸存者偏差提示：深度序列以当前成分股重建，故分位背景仅取成熟样本区间）。

McClellan Oscillator麦克莱伦振荡指标 ?Ratio-adjusted McClellan Oscillator: the 19-day minus 39-day EMA of net advances (normalised so a changing universe size doesn't distort it). Above zero & rising = breadth momentum building; below zero & falling = internals rolling over. The Summation Index is its running total — its slope and sign carry the meaning, not the absolute (cumulative) level.比率调整后的麦克莱伦振荡指标：净上涨家数的19日与39日指数均线之差（已归一化，避免样本规模变化造成失真）。高于零且上行 = 广度动量在累积；低于零且下行 = 内部结构在回落。累积指标是其累计和 — 关键在斜率与正负号，而非绝对（累计）水平。

Breadth Thrust (Zweig)广度脉冲（兹威格） ?The 10-day EMA of the advancers' share, advances / (advances + declines). Zweig's classic launch signal fires when it surges from below 0.40 (washed out) through 0.615 (thrust) inside 10 days — a rare, powerful 'everything's going up at once' kick-off. HONESTY: on our survivorship-biased S&P-500 proxy the strict crossing fires far more often than the canonical ~once-a-decade NYSE signal (rebuilt-from-survivors rebounds look broader than they were live), so read this as a momentum gauge, not the rare historic trigger.上涨家数占比（上涨 /(上涨+下跌)）的10日指数均线。兹威格的经典启动信号：在10日内自0.40以下（超卖）急升突破0.615（脉冲）时触发 —— 罕见而强劲的「同涨」启动。诚实说明：在带有幸存者偏差的标普500代理上，严格的穿越远比经典的纽交所「十年一遇」信号更频繁（以幸存者重建的反弹看起来比当时更广），故此处作为动量计读取，而非罕见的历史触发。

High-Low Index新高—新低指数 ?The 10-day average of the record-high percent: 52-week new highs as a share of (new highs + new lows). Above 50 = new highs are outpacing new lows (an expanding, healthy new-high ledger); below 50 = the new-low side is winning (deterioration). Today's raw net new highs (highs minus lows) and their 10-day average are shown below.记录新高占比的10日均值：52周新高占（新高+新低）的比例。高于50 = 新高多于新低（新高账本在扩张、健康）；低于50 = 新低占上风（恶化）。下方显示今日净新高（新高减新低）及其10日均值。

A/D line vs price腾落线对价格 ?Does the cumulative advance/decline line confirm the index's recent extremes? If price prints a fresh 3-month high the A/D line will NOT confirm, the advance is narrowing underneath (bearish divergence); a fresh price low the A/D line refuses to confirm is a bullish divergence. Otherwise the internals are confirming the move, or nothing is at an extreme (in range). The sparkline traces the A/D line; the correlation is price-vs-A/D over the last 60 sessions.累积腾落线是否确认指数近期的极值？若价格创3个月新高而腾落线未确认，则上涨在底层收窄（看跌背离）；若价格创新低而腾落线拒绝确认，则为看涨背离。否则即为内部结构确认走势，或均未触及极值（区间内）。曲线描绘腾落线；相关系数为近60个交易日价格与腾落线的相关性。

Participation in context参与度的历史背景 ?Today's % of S&P 500 stocks above their 50-day line, set against its own deep history: the percentile tells you where this reading ranks vs every day since the universe matured, and the 20-day change is the momentum of participation (is it broadening or thinning?). Turn Setups — early bottoming signs by stock拐点形态 — 个股早期筑底迹象 ? A per-stock checklist of early bottoming signs — more filled boxes = more timeframes agreeing. Not a buy list and not a return forecast: in 26 past cases about 6 in 10 of these signs faded within a day. The four boxes: D = daily momentum turned up; 3D = the house 3-day entry signal; W = weekly (filled = confirmed, dashed = approaching); 2W = biweekly. TURNING UP = 3+ boxes filled including a weekly one · EARLY SIGN = 2 boxes. Monthly phase is anti-trap context only, not a gate. Mag 7 members always shown. Updates after each nightly run. 个股早期筑底迹象检查表 — 实心格越多，代表越多时间框架同向。 非买入清单、非收益预测：历史26次中约六成迹象在一天内消退。 四个格子：D=日线动能转上；3D=本系统3日入场信号； W=周线（实心=确认，虚线=接近）；2W=双周线。 转强确认=3格以上且含周线级 · 初步迹象=2格。 月线阶段仅作防陷阱参考，非门控。 七巨头成分始终显示。每晚更新。

Thresholds are uncalibrated until more snapshot history accumulates.每只板块 SPDR 的前十大权重；每只持仓的权重变动被拆分为“由个股自身价格变动解释的部分”与“残差”（“主动”=权重增长超过价格涨幅的部分）。较大的正残差=除市场漂移外确有真实买盘流入该股。诚实提示：这些 SPDR 是被动指数基金，故残差代表指数再平衡／流通权重调整带来的资金流（被动强制买入），并非主动经理的信念——后者要等到计划中的前 200 ETF 页面里的主动基金。技术面列显示个股自身的周期状态；✅ 表示增持同时出现了正在形成的买入形态。在积累更多快照历史前，阈值尚未校准。

“Active Δwt” strips out price: it is the percentage points of weight a name gained beyond what its own price move explains. On passive index ETFs this captures index reconstitution / float-weight flow, not a manager’s discretion. The estimated $ flow applies the active Δwt to the fund’s AUM and is approximate.“主动权重Δ”已剔除价格因素：它是个股权重增长中超出其自身价格涨幅所能解释的百分点。在被动指数 ETF 上，这反映的是指数再平衡／流通权重调整带来的资金流，而非经理人的主动决策。估算的美元资金流是将“主动权重Δ”乘以基金 AUM 得出的近似值。
